We first specify the massive Schwinger model and its staggered Kogut–Susskind Hamiltonian formulation, together with the external-charge setup used to generate the expanding electric string [11, 17, 23, 24]. We then give the numerical tensor-network details needed for the real-time evolution and the analysis of midpoint electric-field probabilities and entanglement entropies of the relevant wavefunction components.
